report.summary: Patient P-D006 (Gerald Pruitt, 59, uninsured/self-pay, home tract 17031290900, Chicago) needs help with medication costs and transportation. Meds: tiotropium brand inhaler $420/month (45-day refill gap), albuterol $30/month (10-day gap), amlodipine $4/month. Screener (2026-10-09) reports transportation need = yes and food worry sometimes true. Tract: 41% no-vehicle, 36 transit stops within 800m, low-income area. Clinic appt:2 (primary care, 2026-10-23 14:00) could not be geocoded for transit check. Transport benefit: none.

options.name: Clinic Rx Fund
options.how_to_access: Ask clinic social work/front desk to apply; short-term copay help for current patients.

options.name: Community Pharmacy Assistance
options.how_to_access: Call for help applying to manufacturer patient-assistance programs for the tiotropium inhaler (note: Extra Help generally requires Medicare, patient is 59/uninsured so likely not eligible).

options.name: Neighborhood Pharmacy Fund
options.how_to_access: Directory page returned only a registration placeholder; verify with clinic before referring.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk (ADA paratransit)
options.how_to_access: Apply by phone for ADA paratransit certification; decisions take up to 21 days — start now for future appointments.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West
options.how_to_access: Free weekday rides 7 AM-5 PM to medical appointments, but age 60+ required — patient is 59, NOT currently eligible.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line
options.how_to_access: For Medicaid plan members only; patient is uninsured, NOT eligible unless coverage is established.
